# Zero Block Content

A multi-purpose content block for explaining core values, product features, or general documentation details.

## Properties

- **Section Title (`title`)**: Overall section heading.
- **Primary Content (`content`)**: Main copy paragraph.
- **Secondary Content (`sideContent`)**: Secondary paragraph for split text layouts.
- **Media Asset URL (`mediaUrl`)**: Image or video asset URL path.
- **Layout Display (`layout`)**:
  - `layout-1`: Split text column (Headline left, description copy right)
  - `layout-2`: Side-by-side graphic copy (Image left, copy right)
- **Theme Mode (`themeStyle`)**: `light` / `dark`
